$comment: Single source of truth for hardcoded CURRENT-version strings in the public site/docs that MUST be bumped on every release. Enforced by scripts/check-version-strings.ts (run as `npm run check:versions` locally and as a hard preflight gate in .github/workflows/release.yml). The check asserts each listed file contains the release version at least `occurrences` times AND contains no stale patch of the same minor line (e.g. a leftover v0.11.1 when releasing v0.11.2). Dynamic surfaces that read package.json — the website hero badge (src/pages/index.tsx), the announcement bar and JSON-LD softwareVersion (docusaurus.config.ts) — are intentionally NOT listed; they never drift. Future-milestone references (v1.0 / v1.0 GA) are conceptual, not the current version, and are NOT tracked.
